status_of_this_file: Claude Code evidence-verifier subagent verdicts (adversarial second read of the event-extractor outputs). REVIEW AID ONLY. Not human review; nothing here is accepted. Verdicts PASS means 'quotes verbatim and semantically supported, with warnings', not 'event accepted'.
cross_cutting_findings: Historical availability on 2022-04-01 is supported only by the embedded GPO header / FR Doc number / filing line in every document; no independent archival confirmation exists (manifest historical_date_approved=false everywhere).
Stored text passed through Cloudflare (GovInfo CDN): e-mail addresses replaced by __cf_email__ spans in 70/100 docs; no extracted quote depends on them. Collector now decodes these for future runs.

affected_group is frequently a mild inference beyond source wording (adds actor roles such as importers, operators, pilots, tribes, NPDES-permitted). Human extractor must restrict to source-named parties.
effective_at evidence quotes are sometimes weakly targeted (comment-deadline or boilerplate text attached instead of the DATES line); values themselves were judged correct in all 14.

Many final rules are the last stage of a proposed->final chain first published in an earlier FR document. Dedup (underlying_change_key) must link these chains: 2022-06197 <- 86 FR 1452 / 79 FR 71714; 2022-06517 <- 87 FR 16560 (derivative effective-date notice); 2022-06648 <- 86 FR 3016 / 86 FR 46811 / 81 FR 95489; 2022-06834 <- 87 FR 9021 / 87 FR 12604; 2022-06842 <- 87 FR 2389 / 86 FR 72911; 2022-06852 <- 86 FR 53358 (FINRA); 2022-06879 <- 81 FR 85417 / 85 FR 28494 (reinstatement); 2022-06927 <- 85 FR 84304 / 86 FR 64186.

First public availability can precede FR publication (e.g., FCC 22-6 released 2022-01-26 on fcc.gov for 2022-06503; SRO filing operative 2022-03-15 for 2022-06852). publication_date must not be equated with first availability (AGENTS rule 2).
